newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian envoy to EU to resign soon - minister.
newsitem.headline: Colombian envoy to EU to resign soon - minister.

text.p: Colombia's ambassador to the European Union, a diplomat linked in recent news reports to right-wing paramilitary activity, is preparing to step down, a senior government official said.
Foreign Minister Maria Emma Mejia, in a television news interview late on Saturday, said Carlos Arturo Marulanda was likely to tender his resignation within the next 48 hours.
"We expect his resignation here by next Monday," she told the 24 Horas TV news programme.

No further details were available. Mejia told reporters last month that growing pressure from some European countries and human rights groups for Marulanda's removal as ambassador to the EU had been a cause of "enormous concern" to Bogota.

Recent editorials and a report in the El Espectador newspaper have alleged links betweeen Marulanda and his brother to paramilitary activity, political killings and the evictions of landless peasants from their family's sprawling estate in northern Cesar province.
Marulanda, who was appointed ambassador the EU by former president Cesar Gaviria, has denied any wrongdoing.
